python -c "
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from phase1_pipeline import split_features_targets, save_dataset, build_feature_matrix
import pandas as pd
print('Imports OK')
# Use dummy data with targets included
raw = pd.DataFrame({'formula_pretty': ['BN', 'SiC', 'AlN'], 'bulk_modulus_vrh': [200, 230, 210], 'band_gap_ev': [4.5, 2.3, 3.2]})
df = build_feature_matrix(raw, formula_col='formula_pretty')
df['bulk_modulus_vrh'] = raw['bulk_modulus_vrh'].values
df['band_gap_ev'] = raw['band_gap_ev'].values
print('Full dataset shape:', df.shape)
X, y = split_features_targets(df)
print('Split: X=', X.shape, 'y=', y.shape)
print('Target columns:', list(y.columns))
print('Has targets?', set(y.columns) == {'bulk_modulus_vrh', 'band_gap_ev'})
# Save
path = save_dataset(df, 'materials_thermal_dataset.csv')
print('Saved to:', path)
# Verify file exists
print('File exists?', os.path.exists('materials_thermal_dataset.csv'))
print('File size (bytes):', os.path.getsize('materials_thermal_dataset.csv'))
"
